purpose: Does the ORI aggregator carry what the provider harvest already ledgered? Tests design/aggregator-registry.md §7 item 3 (ORI-complete != publisher-complete) with a measurement instead of a caution, and proves URN equality against REAL ledger rows rather than fixtures.
method: For every ledgered vlaardingen_raad item, prefix-match its provider document id against ORI's original_url, then re-derive the natural key with OriElasticStrategy._parse and compare URNs.

ledger_sample.caveat: This is the Stage-B recent test slice, NOT a full backfill: it is exactly the window where aggregator lag is most likely, so the miss rate below must NOT be read as ORI's overall coverage. A separate 401-item spot walk over 2010-2013 found 401/401 carrying page text.

urn_equality.result: EXACT: every document ORI carries re-derives to the same URN the Notubiz harvest assigned. Switching routes re-keys nothing.

coverage_gap.reading: 28 of 89 are absent from ORI despite being dated INSIDE the window ORI covers, and they are ordinary PDFs (besluitenlijsten, raadsbesluiten). Two mechanisms fit and this probe does NOT distinguish them: (a) ORI harvested those meetings before the documents were attached and has not reindexed, (b) a genuine harvest gap. Either way the aggregator's recent-window coverage is materially incomplete, so discovery.completeness_claim: aggregator is a substantive declaration, not a formality.
